ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Refusing to walk when the ground slopes downward means failing to take an opening already made easy; the paired warning says such an opportune moment is hard to meet again.
EvidenceBody: Foguo Weibai closes a hall question with the whole pair. Dahui Zonggao adds it after supplying a name in the Huangbo–Pei Xiu case, and a later case anthology preserves that same comment. Donglin Changzong gives the pair itself as his answer to “what is the unmoving honored one?”
